name: SavedViews
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; every listing screen in the kernel already syncs filters to the URL — this makes a filter set nameable and reusable)
description: Named, per-user filter sets for any listing screen: save the filters you are looking at, name them, pick a default that applies on open, and optionally share one with the team. Pairs with the kernel's useFilters + AppPaginationTable.
